current_clamp.tolerance: voltage feature ≤ 3 mV residual; > 80% timepoints clear

diagnostics.baseline_pre_residual_explanation: Brian2 starts at v_init=-25mV; NEURON settles via membrane equation toward true rest potential (~-46.82 mV given the leak parameters). Both cells reach near-identical peak and plateau, validating channel implementation. The baseline residual is a v_init initialization mismatch, not a translation error.
diagnostics.settling_time_residual_explanation: Neither cell returns fully to baseline within 1500ms post-stim because EGL-19 alone has no active termination (no SLO-1, no K-current). This matches spec's expectation: 'CP3 will likely show that EGL-19 alone doesn't produce sustained plateau (Mellem amplitude target requires SLO-1 termination dynamics, which we don't have yet). This is expected, NOT a failure.' Note: Mellem-style sustained plateau itself (target Gate 2b) is not the criterion; CP3 validates implementation correctness, not phenotype.
diagnostics.phenotype_reproduction_status: Not applicable — Gate 2b territory after full essential set translated.

cell_construction.rationale: EGL-19 has no Ca-dependent inactivation in Nicoletti's parameterization (verified by reading egl19.mod DERIVATIVE block — only voltage-dependent m, h gates). caintra1 is bookkeeping; nothing reads cai for V dynamics in this subset. cadiff omitted because cadiff and caintra1 are mutually exclusive cai writers (NMODL multi-writer), and caintra1 is what AIY/RIM use.
cell_construction.conductances: AVAL leak (g=0.150164 nS rescaled) + AVAL EGL-19 (g=0.104385 nS rescaled), e_leak=-39 mV

issues_surfaced: Baseline_pre divergence 13.125 mV is initialization, not translation. Brian2 v_init=-25 mV; NEURON's finitialize+settle reaches -46.82 mV. Doesn't affect peak/plateau alignment (both cells relax during 200 ms settle window then peak/plateau align within 0.3 mV).
Settling time differs by ~1250 ms because EGL-19 alone has no termination machinery. Expected per spec; not a translation defect.
key_decisions: Cell subset for CP3: [leak + EGL-19 + caintra1] — caintra1 is bookkeeping (no cai consumer in subset), cadiff omitted to avoid NMODL multi-writer.
VC protocol: 50 ms prestep at -60 + 200 ms test step + 2 ms skip on initial transient. Same as CP2.
CC protocol: Mellem-style 50 pA × 100 ms with 200 ms settle + 1500 ms post, v_rest=-25 mV (matches plateau-harness convention).
